meta_description: Post-quantum IP portfolio readied — crypto-agile IP blocks delivered ahead of the standards freeze and two flagship design wins attributed to the roadmap

blocks.x: Post-quantum IP portfolio readied — crypto-agile IP blocks delivered ahead of the standards freeze and two flagship design wins attributed to the roadmap
Identity withheld — a semiconductor IP vendor whose customers asked about post-quantum and whose answer had been a roadmap slide. Figures are the client's own, shared with permission.

The baseline diagnostic inventoried before promising: IP blocks carrying 23 crypto assumptions, standards timelines converging faster than the roadmap, and two customers explicitly scoring PQC readiness in RFPs the vendor had lost.
The gap wasn't research — it was productization: crypto-agile interfaces, algorithm flexibility at the block level, and the validation story customers' compliance teams require.

We productized the readiness: IP block interfaces refactored for algorithm agility, PQC candidate suites integrated behind the agility layer with validation harnesses per target process node, the migration roadmap published to customers with dated milestones, and the RFP response pack generated from the validation evidence. The roadmap slide became shipping silicon.
